entry.title: New: dsh-human-task#dsh-human-task
entry.summary: Human-in-the-loop tools (`human_task` / `human_task_ready_check`): pause the agent until the user performs a real-world action or returns an observation (GUI operation, game testing, visual verification, hardware checks), gated by session consent and an AFK presence check, returning a structured JSON result via a web task dialog. Exact install spec: github:ywgatustcbbs/dsh-human-task#path:/packages/dsh-human-task. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
